headline: Springfield Public Library cybersecurity review by Wolf & Company moved to closed executive session.
summary: The Office of Internal Audit engaged Wolf & Company as part of the annual audit plan to review the library's cybersecurity controls. The review was meant to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend ways to strengthen information security. The committee voted to go into executive session on deploying security personnel, devices, or strategies, and said it would not return to open session.
discussion: Executive session setup: Attorney Moore advised that a roll-call vote was needed to enter executive session, and members asked how to handle a separate link and people who join late.

Library cybersecurity review: The Office of Internal Audit said Wolf & Company would evaluate the library's controls, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend fixes, but the committee went into executive session before the presentation.
